title: NormalizedForensicRecord
description: The shared envelope every extractor (any language) must produce before writing to forensic_records. This file is the single source of truth — contracts/normalized_record.py (Pydantic) and contracts/normalizedRecord.ts (Zod) are both hand-kept in sync with it. If you change one, change all three in the same commit.

incident_id.description: Correlation key when the source format provides one (e.g. crash report UUID). Null for source types without a natural incident concept (e.g. a single syslog line).

source_type.description: Which extractor produced this record. Add new values here FIRST when introducing a new extractor — this enum is the registration point.

event_time.description: ISO-8601, normalized to a consistent timezone (UTC recommended) by the extractor. This is the field that makes cross-domain correlation possible — every extractor must convert its native timestamp format into this shape, not pass it through raw.

bug_type.description: Crash-domain specific (Apple's .ips bug_type code). Null for all other source types.

fields.description: Type-specific normalized data. Schema for this object's contents is owned by the extractor for that source_type (e.g. crash_report's fields carry exception/termination/lineage; safari_history's fields carry url/visit_count/last_visit). Not validated by this top-level schema on purpose — each extractor documents its own fields shape in its own README.
